functions.source:
BEGIN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('uses',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'journalUseId',u.journal_use_id,'vatUseId',u.vat_use_id,'confirmationId',u.confirmation_id,
    'returnId',u.return_id,'subjectId',u.subject_id,'periodFrom',u.period_from,'periodTo',u.period_to,
    'planHash',u.plan_hash,'status',state.value->>'status',
    'diagnosticCode',state.value->>'diagnosticCode','diagnosticMessage',state.value->>'diagnosticMessage',
    'createdAt',u.created_at,'releasedAt',x.created_at,'releaseReason',x.reason)
    ORDER BY u.created_at DESC,u.journal_use_id DESC)
    FROM (SELECT * FROM finance_journal_uses WHERE subject_id=p_subject ORDER BY created_at DESC,journal_use_id DESC LIMIT 20) u
    LEFT JOIN finance_journal_use_releases x USING(journal_use_id)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT finance_journal_use_state(u.journal_use_id) value) state
    ),'[]'::jsonb),
    'limited',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM finance_journal_uses WHERE subject_id=p_subject OFFSET 20));
END

functions.name: finance_journal_use_lock
finance_journal_use_lookup
functions.source:
BEGIN
  PERFORM finance_journal_use_require(
    p_subject IS NOT NULL AND length(p_subject)>0
    AND COALESCE(array_length(p_vat_use_ids,1),0) BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(p_vat_use_ids) value WHERE value IS NULL OR value='' OR length(value)>200),
    'Journal use lookup scope unavailable');
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('uses',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'journalUseId',u.journal_use_id,'vatUseId',u.vat_use_id,'confirmationId',u.confirmation_id,
    'returnId',u.return_id,'subjectId',u.subject_id,'periodFrom',u.period_from,'periodTo',u.period_to,
    'planHash',u.plan_hash,'status',state.value->>'status',
    'diagnosticCode',state.value->>'diagnosticCode','diagnosticMessage',state.value->>'diagnosticMessage',
    'createdAt',u.created_at,'releasedAt',x.created_at,'releaseReason',x.reason)
    ORDER BY u.created_at DESC,u.journal_use_id DESC)
    FROM finance_journal_uses u LEFT JOIN finance_journal_use_releases x USING(journal_use_id)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT finance_journal_use_state(u.journal_use_id) value) state
    WHERE u.subject_id=p_subject AND u.vat_use_id=ANY(p_vat_use_ids)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'limited',false);
END
